_about: Labeled texts for evaluating deadline extraction. expect_offset_days is the true deadline relative to the fixed reference date 2026-08-03 (or null when the text states no deadline). Offsets here avoid weekday ambiguity; weekday parsing is covered in tests/test_extraction.py.
